name: Yordano
scope: Dedicated Yordano audit. Only this report and tests/character-audits/yordano.test.ts were written in the repository. No runtime edits, commits, additional server or child agents.
sourceRevision: 2273843fe788fb68bfa35d80d9ec87b48f1d2b7e with parent task's staged shared-engine fixes; fresh test process used after the shared files changed.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: The dossier identifies an Italian-Venezuelan singer-songwriter and connects Manantial to the fictional water arcs. This audit preserves its existing sources and portrait description; no new broad research was performed.
identityAndPortrayal.visualMatch: All inspected poses retain short silver hair, receding hairline, clean-shaven narrow face, dark rectangular glasses, black jacket, patterned charcoal shirt, black trousers and shoes. The eight sprites remain recognizable and complete when mirrored.
identityAndPortrayal.audio: Dossier realVoice=false; the reaction bank points to generic effort and pain clips and the fountain cue uses synthesized sine notes. Audio playback and synchronization were not reviewed.

movementAndStance.movement: At x540, 24 right inputs reach x637.4288358024536, then 24 left inputs reach x548.1708998322179. Facing changes with movement; both player sides reproduce exactly.
movementAndStance.jump: First jump reaches y454.6 after 10 calls. Second jump accepted, third rejected; 100 further calls land at y554 with grounded=true, jumps=0 and two stocks.
movementAndStance.frames: Production drawSprite inspected greeting0, guard/battle1, walk2/3, jump4, light/special/super5, heavy6 and hurt7 on both facings. No clipped extremity, neighboring fragment or wrong facing was observed.

special.name: Manantial en tres tiempos
special.reproducibleSetup: Finish the 510-tick Poliedro intro. Yordano P1 at x230 and Javier at x630, or Yordano P2 at x850 and Javier at x450; both grounded y554, both energy100. Increment Yordano special once on first active input. Ticks below are simulation ticks relative to the end of intro; hitstop freezes simulation tick.
special.emissions: All three drops appear at attack/simulation ticks 13, 26 and 39. First observed age1 has y470.3 and vy-8.7. Horizontal velocity is +7.2 for P1 and -7.2 for P2. Yordano remains at his initial x.
special.trajectory: Every observed sample of all three drops on both sides matches x=origin+facing*(48+7.2*age), y=479-9*age+0.15*age*(age+1), vy=-9+0.3*age. Apex y348.5. In a collision-free grounded gap230 probe each survives through age64, then expires at the floor threshold rather than bouncing. No groundOnly restriction.

forwardGuard.inputs: Javier block=true, no movement; grounded auto-facing toward Yordano

rearGuard.inputs: Javier block=true and right=true against P1, or left=true against P2; moves away and faces away

antiAir.setup: Same origin, gap230 instead of400; increment Javier jump and Yordano special together on first active call.

special.mirrored: Test compares complete normalized emission/impact/guard evidence across both player sides, not just final damage.
special.energyGate: Energy100 spends25 immediately; energy24 rejects special on either side.
special.rangeInterpretation: A stationary grounded rival at gap230 or300 can be underneath the arc and remain unharmed. At gap230 a jumping rival is hit. Probe results at grounded gaps120/400/460/500 are respectively 1/3/2/1 hits; moving rear guard changes where its body meets the descending arc. These are reproducible arc geometry, not an identified defect.

attacksAndCombos.light: Gap80 connects once for7.21 damage against Javier; front guard prevents HP loss on both sides. Outward knockback has the expected sign.
attacksAndCombos.heavy: Gap80 connects once for13.39 damage; front guard prevents HP loss on both sides. No repeated hit after40 further calls.
attacksAndCombos.baseCombo: Agua clara (L→H) connects both hits with real chase inputs; heavy bonus3, final Javier HP76.31, elapsed67 simulation ticks on both sides.
attacksAndCombos.advancedCombo: Ida y vuelta (L→L→H) connects all three hits with chase; requires at least one win, bonus7, final HP64.98, elapsed113 ticks on both sides.
attacksAndCombos.winGate: Separate gap140 L→L→H recognition probe yields Agua clara/bonus3 at zero wins, Ida y vuelta/bonus7 at one win; initial lights whiff by design and heavy lands. Connected tests independently prove every strike can connect.
attacksAndCombos.super: Tres tiempos requires three wins and75 energy. Gap200, active tick9, one hit for (28+12)*1.03=41.2 damage, target HP58.8 on both sides. Zero/two wins or energy74 reject it. It currently uses the shared close-range super.

cpuFight.method: Finish intro; leave Yordano idle180 calls to exercise CPU offense; then run real approach, guard, jump and light/heavy/special/super inputs. Compare two complete final states and tracked attacks.
cpuFight.limitation: Special and super start but do not land in this particular CPU bout; dedicated collision/gate tests separately verify them. This controller is an exercised deterministic fight, not a balance evaluation.

introAndSelection.name: Invitación del cantautor
introAndSelection.choreography: Palmas abiertas y pulso de cantautor in source routine; resolved choreography name is Invitación del cantautor.
introAndSelection.method: Production loadSprite, drawSprite and drawPresentation imported into an ephemeral canvas in this agent's own native T3 tab. No repository visual harness or alternate browser system was created.
introAndSelection.observation: Intro and selection are inspected at each sample on both facings. Guard opens to calm open palms and slight rhythmic posture, then returns to frame1 guard. Silver hair, glasses, anatomy and shoes stay coherent; head and extended hands face the rival after mirroring.
introAndSelection.oneShot: selectionProgress clamps to1 at2800ms and remains1 at5600ms. Both final sampled pose definitions are frame1 with dx=dy=0. Shared intro rejects attacks/movement until tick510 and ends facing the rival on both sides.
introAndSelection.transientFailure: Shared dev server briefly disconnected at02:18:38 UTC and the same owned tab automatically reconnected at02:18:40. Both screenshots were captured after recovery. Console retained Vite/WebSocket connection warnings from this environment interruption.
introAndSelection.limitations: Representative static samples through actual rendering code, not every interpolated frame or ordinary lobby interaction. Yordano has no dedicated entrance atlas; his current entrance uses the production articulated combat sprite. Audio was not listened to.

recommendation: Retain Yordano's current mechanics, likeness and greeting. No current reproducible character-specific defect requires a runtime edit.

checksActuallyRun: Walking/facing both ways, double jump, third rejection, landing on both sides
Light/heavy damage, single contact, front guard and outward knockback
All three timed fountain drops, analytic arcing samples and floor expiry
Idle/front/rear special collisions and exact mirrored side evidence
Connected base/advanced chase combos and zero/one-win recognition gate
Full 510-tick intro action gate on both sides
Complete normal CPU fight and exact full-state replay
Native eight-frame sprite and intro/selection snapshots on both facings
